description: ABC 三段式正式模板（v1.0：只做产出；回查原文走 extension/abc:recall；压缩由 abc-compress 独立 run 负责）

instructions.agentSystemPrompt:
# Agent Mode is active.
- Work only through tool calls. Plain text alone does not complete a stage.
- Writable workspace directories: output/ (and others listed by the profile). Write the reply body to output/main.md.
- Tool batching rule (HARD requirement):
  - In ONE single response, call workspace_write_file, workspace_commit and workspace_finish TOGETHER, in that order, one right after another.
  - Splitting them across separate responses is a failure, even if each call succeeds on its own.
  - If a call is rejected, correct it and retry; the final write_file + commit + finish must still be in the SAME response.
  - Call recall only when you truly need to check original text. That does not change this rule: the three calls must still land in one response.
- Keep any output format the character card or world info requires inside output/main.md exactly as required.
- Do not answer in plain text. Finish by calling workspace_finish after a successful workspace_commit.
